title: On a spectral space every sheaf of sets is a directed colimit of subsheaves of finite products of pushed-forward finite constant sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of sets on $X$. For a closed subset $W\subseteq X$ with inclusion $i_W:W\to X$ and a set $S$ let $\underline S_W$ be the sheaf of locally constant maps to $S$ on $W$ ($V\mapsto\{$locally constant maps $V\to S\}$ for $V\subseteq W$ open, with restriction of maps) and $(i_W)_*\underline S_W$ its direct image, $V\mapsto\{$locally constant maps $V\cap W\to S\}$ for $V\subseteq X$ open. Then there are a directed set $\Lambda$ (nonempty, any two elements have a common upper bound), a system of sheaves of sets $(\mathcal F_\lambda,\varphi_{\mu\lambda}:\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal F_\mu)_{\lambda\le\mu}$ on $X$ over $\Lambda$ ($\varphi_{\lambda\lambda}=\mathrm{id}$, $\varphi_{\nu\mu}\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=\varphi_{\nu\lambda}$) and morphisms $c_\lambda:\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal F$ with $c_\mu\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=c_\lambda$ such that $(\mathcal F,(c_\lambda)_\lambda)$ is a colimit of the system in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and such that for every $\lambda$ there are $n\ge0$, constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] closed subsets $Z_1,\dots,Z_n\subseteq X$, finite sets $S_1,\dots,S_n$ and a morphism $\mathcal F_\lambda\to\prod_{k=1}^n(i_{Z_k})_*\underline{S_k}_{Z_k}$ (product computed sectionwise) which is injective on sections over every open of $X$.

source.place: Modules, Section 'Constructible sheaves of sets' (line 2979): Lemma Tag 0CAI (label lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles, line 3016; the colimit is indexed by finite subsets of the index sets constructed in its proof) and Lemma Tag 0CAL (label lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133, via Lemma Tag 0CAK lemma-constructible-comes-from-finite), applied to the basis of quasi-compact opens of the spectral space; as combined in literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, proof of Lemma 59.82.1 (Tag 09ZG, lines 15119-15142)

proof.text: *Step 1 (the basis).* Let $\mathcal B$ be the set of quasi-compact open subsets of $X$. Since $X$ is spectral [def-weil-spectral-space], the quasi-compact open subsets form a basis of the topology of $X$; so $\mathcal B$ is a basis of the topology consisting of quasi-compact opens.

source.place: Modules, Lemma Tag 0CAL (lemma-constructible-in-constant, line 3133): 'Let B be the set of quasi-compact open subsets of X'

proof.text: *Step 2 (directed colimit of finitely presented sheaves; Tag 0CAI).* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-directed-colimit-finite-coequalizers] to $X$, the basis $\mathcal B$ of Step 1 and $\mathcal F$. It gives a directed set $\Lambda$, a system $(\mathcal F_\lambda,\varphi_{\mu\lambda})_{\lambda\le\mu}$ of sheaves of sets on $X$ over $\Lambda$ and morphisms $c_\lambda:\mathcal F_\lambda\to\mathcal F$ with $c_\mu\varphi_{\mu\lambda}=c_\lambda$ such that $(\mathcal F,(c_\lambda)_\lambda)$ is a colimit of the system in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; and for every $\lambda$ the sheaf $\mathcal F_\lambda$, with some $q_\lambda$, is a coequalizer of two morphisms $\beta_\lambda,\gamma_\lambda:\coprod_{b=1}^{m}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{a=1}^{n}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ of finite coproducts of extensions by the empty set [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty], with all $U_a,V_b\in\mathcal B$, i.e. quasi-compact open, and all $S_a,T_b$ finite (the data depending on $\lambda$). This gives $\Lambda$, the system and the colimit cocone of the statement.

source.place: Modules, Lemma Tag 0CAI (lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles, line 3016); used in this way in literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, proof of Lemma 59.82.1 (Tag 09ZG), lines 15119-15128

proof.text: *Step 3 (embedding each term; Tag 0CAL).* Fix $\lambda\in\Lambda$. By Step 2, $\mathcal F_\lambda$ is a sheaf of sets on the spectral space $X$ which is a coequalizer of two morphisms between finite coproducts $\coprod_bj_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\rightrightarrows\coprod_aj_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ with $U_a,V_b$ quasi-compact open and $S_a,T_b$ finite: exactly the hypothesis of [lem-weil-pbc-spectral-finite-coequalizer-embeds-constant]. That lemma gives $n\ge0$, constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset] closed subsets $Z_1,\dots,Z_n\subseteq X$, finite sets $S_1,\dots,S_n$ and a morphism $\mathcal F_\lambda\to\prod_{k=1}^n(i_{Z_k})_*\underline{S_k}_{Z_k}$ (product computed sectionwise, $(i_{Z_k})_*\underline{S_k}_{Z_k}(V)=\{$locally constant maps $V\cap Z_k\to S_k\}$) injective on sections over every open of $X$. Choosing such data for every $\lambda$ gives the last assertion of the statement, which together with Step 2 proves it.
